entities.name: Requested mapped NSSAI
entities.description: Information element included by the UE when transferring PDN connections or PDU sessions to visited PLMN associated with S-NSSAI applicable in HPLMN.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that includes the Requested mapped NSSAI IE under specific conditions.

entities.name: PDN connection or PDU session transfer condition
entities.description: Condition where UE has a PDN connection or PDU session to transfer to visited PLMN associated with S-NSSAI applicable in HPLMN.

entities.name: Visited PLMN
entities.description: The visited public land mobile network to which PDN connections or PDU sessions are transferred.

entities.name: Home PLMN
entities.description: The home public land mobile network where the S-NSSAI must be applicable.

relations.description: UE includes the Requested mapped NSSAI IE when specific conditions are met.
Inclusion of Requested mapped NSSAI IE is guarded by the condition of PDN connection or PDU session transfer.
The condition establishes transfer to visited PLMN.
The condition establishes that S-NSSAI must be applicable in HPLMN.
